quality_policy.product_reality: Every row is an exact product name/article entry published in a public manufacturer/distributor catalogue.

quality_policy.tariff: NCM is a technical proposal, not a binding customs ruling. Medium-confidence rows require validation against the actual SDS/TDS and percentages.
